pairs.hanzi:
米拉看见箱子，先问坏在哪里。

他没替女儿删掉难听的话，甚至把妇人说的“你们这提把是给矮袖子做的”也照抄在旁边。
苏苡读到那里，笑了一声，米拉没有笑。

pairs.english: On five days leaves were easier to scoop than before, but fine sand remained throughout, and thick clothing still got in the way outside the handles. “Do they want to keep using it?” Mira asked.
pairs.hanzi:
五天里叶子比原先好捞，细沙却始终有，厚衣服挤在提把外侧，也还是碍事。
“那边想不想接着用？”米拉问。

pairs.english: “They ask if you can leave just this leaf screen, something they can lift by the old intake, without the two boxes behind it.”
pairs.hanzi: “他们问能不能只留这个拦叶子的。旧水口边上就能拿起来，不要后头两只箱。”

pairs.english: The workshop fell briefly quiet. Outside someone shook out a large sheet of emery cloth with a puff like a slap on the table. Mira straightened the drawing. “With only one screen, the leaves will pile up straightaway.”

作坊里静了一下。院外有人抖一大张砂布，噗的一声，像拍在桌上。
米拉伸手把图转正。“只留一片，叶子一下就堆住了。”

pairs.hanzi: 苏苡翻到记录背面，找到了两句不同的抱怨。一家写每日都清太费事，另一家说自己清完又给别人用了。字歪，气却看得出来。

“我可以再改。”她说。
“我知道。”父亲答，“可别为了让我回去好说话，就今天答应。”

pairs.english: He had to find somewhere free of drawings to sit. Suyi said she wanted first to turn the useful section into something separately removable.

他只好找了个没占图纸的地方坐。
苏苡说自己想先把好用的那一部分做成能单独取下的东西。

pairs.english: Mira wanted another trial of the complete boxes: the fine sand wasn't caught, cleaning hadn't been organized, and surely they couldn't just stop halfway.

pairs.english: “Separating a screen isn't stopping,” Suyi said. “I don't only get my own work after I've helped you finish yours.” Mira turned, her lips moving briefly without a sound.

“拆出一片不是算了。”苏苡说，“我也不是帮你做完它以后才有自己的事。”
米拉回过头来，嘴唇动了一下，没出声。

pairs.english: After the door closed, Tavi saw Mira raise her hand as if to call her, then slowly lower it. “You think I should dismantle the boxes too?” she asked.
pairs.hanzi:
门关上以后，塔维看见米拉抬起手，似乎想叫她，又慢慢放下。
“你也觉得我该把箱子拆了？”她问。

pairs.target: " wǒ hái méi kàn wán nà jǐzhāng . " " kàn wán zàishuō , yòu búshì ràng nǐ pàn shuí yíng . " tā biàn zhēnde cóng dìyīyè kàn qǐ .
pairs.english: “I haven't finished reading those sheets.” “Read them first, then. I'm not asking you to judge who wins.” So he really started from the first page.
pairs.hanzi:
“我还没看完那几张。”
“看完再说，又不是让你判谁赢。”
他便真的从第一页看起。

pairs.target: kàn le hǎojiǔ , mǐlā yí guò dèngzǐ , zhǐ gěi tā kàn liǎngchù bèi ní gàizhù de zì . xīyáng zhào zài nà liǎngzhī xiāng shàng , céngjīng mó dé guāngliàng de biān , xiànzài yǒu le bùshǎo shēnqiǎn bù yī de shǒuyìn .
pairs.english: After a long while, Mira moved her stool over and showed him two passages obscured by mud. Evening sun fell on the two boxes; their once-polished edges now carried many handprints of varying shades.
pairs.hanzi: 看了好久，米拉移过凳子，指给他看两处被泥盖住的字。夕阳照在那两只箱上，曾经磨得光亮的边，现在有了不少深浅不一的手印。
